exam.title: SQL & Databases Track Exam — Validated Form 001

questions.question: A company wants to reduce duplicate stored values and decrease update inconsistencies. Which database advantage directly addresses this?

options.text: Reduced data redundancy and improved consistency

explanation.ar: تقليل data redundancy بيقلل تكرار نفس البيانات، وده يقلل فرص updating errors ويحسن consistency.

questions.question: A designer is deciding how data should be structured, related, constrained, and accessed before building the database. Which artifact is the designer defining?

explanation.ar: الـ Data Model هو اللي بيحدد structure وrelationships وconstraints وطريقة تنظيم والوصول للبيانات قبل التنفيذ.

questions.question: Which is a composite attribute according to the course examples?

options.text: Full Name = First Name + Last Name

explanation.ar: Composite attribute بيتكوّن من أجزاء أصغر، والمثال في المادة Full Name المكوّن من First Name + Last Name.

questions.question: A designer confuses relationship degree with cardinality. In an ERD, what should be used to decide whether the relationship is 1:1, 1:N, or M:N?

options.text: The number of entity types participating in the relationship
The number of attributes inside the entities
The number of instances of one entity that can relate to instances of another

explanation.ar: 1:1 و1:N وM:N هي Cardinality Ratios، وبتوصف عدد الـ instances المرتبطة، مش عدد الـ entity types المشاركة؛ ده اسمه Degree.

source.reference: Slides 24–25 — Relationship Degree and Cardinality Ratio

questions.question: After completing an ERD, a developer creates one relational table per entity but stores each entity attribute as a separate row instead of a column. What mapping rule is being violated?

options.text: Every relationship must become a weak entity
Entities should become tables and attributes should become columns
Every entity must be converted into a document

explanation.ar: الـ basic mapping rule في المادة واضح: Entity → Table وAttribute → Column. تحويل attributes إلى rows هنا تطبيق خاطئ للـ mapping.

source.reference: Slide 28 — Mapping Entity Diagrams To Tables

questions.question: Why is EmpNo included in the Dependent relation when mapping a weak entity?

options.text: Because the weak entity depends on the parent Employee and needs the parent's key
Because every weak entity must have no relationship to its parent
Because EmpNo is a multivalued attribute
Because weak entities cannot contain foreign keys

explanation.ar: Weak Entity بيعتمد على الـ parent، لذلك Primary Key للـ parent (EmpNo) يدخل في relation بتاع الـ weak entity للربط والتعريف.

questions.question: In a 1:1 relationship where Course has total participation but some Instructors have no Course, which placement shown in the course is appropriate?

options.text: Place every Course value inside Instructor as a list
Place Instructor EmpId as InsNo in Course

explanation.ar: لما Course مشارك كليًا بينما بعض Instructors ممكن مايبقاش عندهم Course، المادة بتحط EmpId الخاص بالـ Instructor كـ InsNo داخل Course.

source.reference: Slide 40 — 1:1 Total participation on one side

questions.question: A project team has finished identifying business requirements and high-level entities, and is about to translate them into a structured logical design before choosing storage details. Which transition best matches the course modeling process?

options.text: Physical Data Model → Conceptual Data Model
Conceptual Data Model → Logical Data Model

explanation.ar: الـ process في المادة يبدأ Conceptual ثم Logical ثم Physical؛ بعد high-level business view الخطوة التالية هي Logical design.

questions.question: A database keeps the same table design for months while rows are inserted and updated every day. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The database instance never changes once created
The schema may remain stable while database instances change over time
Schema and instance are identical concepts
The schema must change every time one row changes

explanation.ar: الـ instance هو snapshot للقيم الحالية ولذلك بيتغير، بينما الـ schema غالبًا يفضل ثابت لأنه بيوصف التصميم.

questions.question: An attribute's value can be determined only when the entire composite primary key is known. Which dependency type is this?

explanation.ar: Full Functional Dependency معناها إن الـ non-key attribute يعتمد على الـ whole Primary Key، مش جزء منه.

questions.question: Which comparison is correct according to the course?

options.text: Snowflake is intended only for simple dashboards
Star always stores less redundant data
Star is generally easier to maintain; Snowflake is more complex

explanation.ar: في المقارنة: Maintenance في Star أسهل، بينما Snowflake أكثر تعقيدًا بسبب normalization وتعدد الجداول.

questions.question: What rule should the CHECK constraint enforce in the Products table according to the lab?

options.text: Price must be greater than zero
Supplier must be stored in the Price column

explanation.ar: المادة بتحدد CHECK constraint للتأكد إن prices في Products أكبر من zero.

questions.question: An existing Customers table must gain a new LoyaltyCode column without replacing the whole table. Which taught command family and action best fit?

explanation.ar: إضافة Column إلى جدول موجود هي Structure change، لذلك تندرج تحت DDL وبالتحديد ALTER TABLE ... ADD.

questions.question: Which comparison correctly distinguishes ALTER and UPDATE based on the session?

options.text: ALTER is DDL for table structure changes, while UPDATE is DML for changes to stored data.
ALTER and UPDATE are both DQL commands.
ALTER inserts rows while UPDATE creates tables.
ALTER deletes rows while UPDATE drops the table structure.

explanation.ar: ALTER يغير table structure، بينما UPDATE ينتمي إلى DML ويستخدم لتغيير البيانات؛ الفرق هو Schema/Structure مقابل Data.

source.reference: Slides 12 and 14 — ALTER vs DML UPDATE

questions.question: What does SELECT * FROM customers; request?

options.text: Only rows where age is greater than 30.
All columns from the customers table.

explanation.ar: النجمة * مع SELECT معناها اختيار كل الأعمدة من الجدول المحدد في FROM.

source.reference: Slide 13 — SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY basics

questions.question: Which DDL statement is listed as creating an index (search key)?

explanation.ar: Session 3 بتذكر CREATE INDEX صراحة كـ DDL لإنشاء index أو search key.

questions.question: What is the risk of omitting WHERE from an UPDATE or DELETE, according to the session?

options.text: The statement can affect all rows.
The query becomes a SELECT statement.
Only the first row is affected.

explanation.ar: المادة بتنبه إن غياب WHERE في UPDATE أو DELETE ممكن يخلي العملية تطبق على كل الصفوف، ودي نقطة troubleshooting مهمة.

questions.question: Using the Slide 22 sample data, a query applies WHERE age > 30 and then ORDER BY age DESC. Which first three names are returned?

options.text: Omar Khalid, Fahad Zayed, Sara Ahmed.
Fahad Zayed, Sara Ahmed, Yousef Nabil.
Fahad Zayed, Omar Khalid, Hani Mansour.
Maya Haddad, Leila Faris, Ali Hassan.

explanation.ar: بعد فلترة age > 30 يبقى 6 عملاء، وترتيبهم تنازليًا يبدأ 45 ثم 41 ثم 36: Fahad ثم Omar ثم Hani.

source.reference: Slides 22–23 — sample data / WHERE and ORDER BY

questions.question: According to the query execution diagram, which clause is processed first?

explanation.ar: الرسم في Slide 2 بيبدأ بـ FROM، وبعدها WHERE ثم GROUP BY ثم HAVING ثم SELECT ثم ORDER BY ثم LIMIT.

questions.question: What is the main role of WHERE?

explanation.ar: WHERE هي filtering clause للـ base rows وبتتنفذ قبل GROUP BY حسب ترتيب التنفيذ المعروض.

questions.question: Which operator means “greater than or equal to”?

explanation.ar: جدول comparison operators في المادة بيحدد >= بمعنى greater than or equal to.

questions.question: What is the difference between DISTINCT and deleting duplicates from the table?

options.text: DISTINCT removes duplicates from query output; it does not delete stored rows.

explanation.ar: المادة بتشرح DISTINCT كإزالة للتكرار من الـ output، بينما حذف duplicates فعليًا له method منفصلة بـ ROW_NUMBER وDELETE.

source.reference: Slides 21 and 23 — DISTINCT vs deleting duplicates

questions.question: Which aggregate functions are shown as usable across various data types?

explanation.ar: المادة بتذكر COUNT وMIN وMAX تحت Various data types.

questions.question: The lab asks to categorize customers by age group. Which SQL feature is explicitly intended for that task?

explanation.ar: الـ lab في Slide 34 بيطلب استخدام CASE لتصنيف العملاء حسب العمر.

questions.question: Which pair is explicitly practiced as date functions in the lab?

explanation.ar: الـ lab يذكر NOW وDATE_ADD ضمن date functions المطلوبة للتدريب.

questions.question: What normalization target is stated for the University project?

explanation.ar: Slide 4 بتذكر صراحة Normalization: Aim for 3NF.

questions.question: Which Course attribute is explicitly marked UNIQUE?

explanation.ar: course_code مذكور كـ UNIQUE natural key في Courses.

questions.question: To answer “Instructors Teaching > 2 Courses” using Teaches, which taught query pattern best matches the requirement?

options.text: Use DISTINCT instructor_id only with no counting.
Delete instructors who teach two courses.
Group teaching rows by instructor and filter groups whose course count is greater than 2.

explanation.ar: المطلوب threshold على عدد courses لكل instructor، فده منطقيًا GROUP BY instructor مع aggregate count ثم HAVING > 2.

questions.question: A designer stores instructor email repeatedly inside every Teaches row even though it already belongs to Instructors. Which project goal does that work against?

options.text: The stated aim for a normalized 3NF design.

explanation.ar: تكرار instructor attribute داخل association table بدون حاجة بيزود redundancy وبيتعارض مع هدف 3NF المذكور للمشروع.

source.reference: Slides 4–5 — Aim for 3NF / normalized entity separation

questions.question: Consider `SELECT e.name, s.name FROM employees e, employees s WHERE e.supervisorID = s.ID`. Which row for an employee with `supervisorID = NULL` will be returned by this equijoin?

options.text: The employee is returned with their own name as supervisor.
The employee is returned with every supervisor.
No row for that employee, because NULL does not match a supervisor ID in the equality condition.
The query automatically converts NULL to 0.

explanation.ar: الشرط `e.supervisorID = s.ID` محتاج match؛ الموظف اللي SupervisorID عنده NULL مش هيلقى صف مطابق في الربط ده.

source.reference: Slides 11–12 — Self Join data and query

questions.question: The RIGHT OUTER JOIN example lists HR even though HR has no assigned employee. Why?

options.text: The WHERE clause creates a fake employee.
The query is actually a Cartesian product.
The departments table is on the preserved right side of the join.

explanation.ar: في المثال `employees e RIGHT OUTER JOIN departments d`، كل صفوف departments لازم تظهر؛ لذلك HR يظهر حتى من غير employee match.

questions.question: An e-commerce report must list only customers who have at least one matching order. Which join behavior is required?

options.text: INNER JOIN between Customers and Orders on CustomerID.
LEFT JOIN with Customers preserved regardless of orders.
FULL OUTER JOIN preserving unmatched rows from both tables.
Cartesian product between Customers and Orders.

explanation.ar: المطلوب customers اللي عندهم order مطابق فقط، وده سلوك INNER JOIN.

questions.question: Table X has 3 rows and table Y has 4 rows. If a Cartesian product is produced, how many row combinations are possible?

explanation.ar: Cartesian Product = كل صف من X مع كل صف من Y، إذن 3 × 4 = 12 combination.

questions.question: What is a subquery (nested query) according to Session 6?

options.text: A complete SELECT query placed inside another SQL query.
A command that permanently changes a table schema.
A Cartesian product with no join condition.

explanation.ar: الـ Subquery أو Nested Query هو SELECT كامل جوه query تاني.

questions.question: A store query needs products whose category ID is in the set of category IDs located in Cairo. Which taught structure matches the Giza department example?

options.text: A self join of Products with itself.
A FULL OUTER JOIN with no condition.

explanation.ar: ده نفس pattern Slide 17: outer table بيتفلتر بـ `IN` على IDs راجعة من subquery داخل WHERE.

questions.question: The E-commerce assignment asks for customer stats such as total spent, order count, and average order value using subqueries in SELECT. Which design matches the requirement?

options.text: Use correlated scalar subqueries in the SELECT list, one per derived customer statistic.
Use a Cartesian product and no aggregation.
Use a self join on Customers with no Orders reference.

explanation.ar: الـ assignment نفسه بيطلب subqueries in SELECT للـ customer stats، وSlide 24 بيوضح scalar correlated subqueries لنفس النوع من derived columns.

source.reference: Slides 24 and 29 — SELECT subqueries and E-commerce assignment

questions.question: Using the same inputs {A,B} and {B,C}, what does UNION ALL return?

explanation.ar: UNION ALL يحتفظ بكل rows من الناحيتين، وبالتالي B تظهر مرتين.

questions.question: Salaries ordered DESC are 9000, 9000, 7000. What RANK() values are assigned?

explanation.ar: مع RANK، الـ ties بياخدوا نفس rank، وبعدهم يحصل gap؛ فـ 9000 و9000 = 1، وبعدهم 7000 = 3.

questions.question: After defining `WITH HighEarners AS (SELECT * FROM Staff WHERE Salary > 7000)`, what rows are available from HighEarners?

options.text: All Staff rows regardless of salary.
Only Staff rows whose Salary is greater than 7000.

explanation.ar: الـ CTE نفسه مبني على filter `Salary > 7000`، فالناتج المؤقت فيه الـ Staff rows اللي عدت الشرط فقط.

questions.question: In the HighEarners example, the main query joins `HighEarners h` to `Departments d` using what relationship?

explanation.ar: المثال بيربط الـ filtered staff بالـ department table على `DeptID` عشان يرجع StaffName مع DeptName.

questions.question: Employees in department A have salaries 50 and 70; department B has 100. For the 70 row, `AVG(salary) OVER(PARTITION BY department)` returns what?

explanation.ar: الـ partition بتاع A فيه 50 و70 فقط، فالمتوسط 60 ويتعرض جنب row الـ 70.

questions.question: A developer writes `AVG(salary) PARTITION BY department_id` without `OVER(...)`. What is the main problem relative to the taught syntax?

options.text: The window specification is missing the OVER(...) wrapper.
AVG cannot be used as a window function.
PARTITION BY must always be replaced by PIVOT.
The query must use DROP INDEX first.

explanation.ar: كل أمثلة الـ window functions في Session 8 بتستخدم `... OVER (...)`; PARTITION BY جزء جوه OVER مش بديل له.

questions.question: What characterizes a single-row subquery in Session 8?

options.text: It returns one value: one row and one column.
It must return every row from a table.
It can only be used with PIVOT.
It always returns a list for IN.

explanation.ar: الـ Single-Row Subquery بيرجع قيمة واحدة فقط، يعني row واحدة وcolumn واحدة.

questions.question: Which set of tools does the Dynamic Pivot slide mention for building and executing the dynamic column list?

options.text: STUFF, FOR XML PATH, and sp_executesql

explanation.ar: السلايد بيذكر STUFF وFOR XML PATH لبناء column-list string، و`sp_executesql` للتنفيذ.

questions.question: If `@stock = 2` and the condition is `IF @stock > 5`, which branch should execute?

explanation.ar: ده external-similar: 2 > 5 = FALSE، فلو ELSE موجود هو اللي هيتنفذ.

questions.question: A transaction performs several DML statements that must act as one safe unit and runtime errors are possible. Which taught design is best?

options.text: Commit before running the DML so errors are ignored.
BEGIN TRANSACTION, TRY the DML, COMMIT on success, and ROLLBACK in CATCH when needed.
Use PIVOT instead of a transaction.
Use RANK to decide whether errors matter.

explanation.ar: ده pattern Slide 25: transaction + TRY/CATCH، COMMIT لو نجح، وROLLBACK داخل CATCH عند الخطأ.

questions.question: Which optional clause appears in the Session 9 CREATE VIEW syntax?

explanation.ar: Slide 6 تعرض WITH CHECK OPTION كـ optional clause في نهاية CREATE VIEW syntax.

questions.question: What does SELECT * FROM EmployeeDepartmentInfo; do after the view from Slide 4 has been created?

options.text: It retrieves the columns and rows exposed by the EmployeeDepartmentInfo view.

explanation.ar: بعد إنشاء الـ View، SELECT * FROM اسم_الـView بيقرأ البيانات اللي الـ View بيعرضها، زي التعامل مع table في SELECT.

questions.question: A team uses a view instead of duplicating base tables when it only needs a simplified reusable result. Why does that choice match Session 9?

options.text: Because a view always stores more data than a table.
It provides a logical reusable SELECT layer without requiring a separate independent copy of the data.
Because views cannot depend on tables.
Because views remove the need for SELECT.

explanation.ar: الـ View بيقدم logical layer reusable فوق البيانات الأصلية، وده يحقق تبسيط الاستعلام والعرض من غير تكرار مستقل للبيانات.

questions.question: A caller wants to run GetEmployeesInDepartment for department 101. Which invocation matches the Session 9 example?

explanation.ar: Slide 26 تعرض EXEC كطريقة تشغيل الـ Stored Procedure مع parameter.

source.reference: Slide 26 — How to Use This Procedure
